_note: Synthetic technician notes for the B-22 gold check (invented; no real ticket or person). Each note is what a technician might have typed while working the ticket. The eval expects every sentence of a note to appear under 'steps tried' in that ticket's escalation package, cited to the note.

notes.description: Power-cycled the firewall and the front desk switch. The WAN light on the firewall stays amber.
Pinged the scanner from the front desk PC and it answers. Re-entered the scan folder path and the error is the same.
Checked the reminder sender in the message trace and it was delivered. Asked the practice for the junk folder headers.
Confirmed the caller by the call-back number on file. Waiting for approval before the sign-in methods are cleared.
Started Outlook in safe mode and it stays open. Disabled the add-ins one at a time and the crash did not return after the CRM add-in was off.
Reviewed the sign-in log for the account and it shows two sessions per sign-in. Cleared the saved credentials in Windows Credential Manager.
Ran a speed test from the trading floor switch and it matches the plan. Moved the market data feed to the second uplink for a test.
Opened a case with the portfolio system vendor and gave them the export log. Waiting for the vendor to reply.
Swapped the HDMI cable for a spare and the screen still shows no signal. Tried a second laptop and got the same result.
Confirmed the call-back number on file with the user. The lead has the sign-in methods change waiting for approval.
Reinstalled the check printing driver on the accounting PC. The error is unchanged and the vendor has the log.
Asked the office manager to confirm the approval in writing. Nothing changed on the docketing calendar yet.
